sources.supports: The archived official pricing page gives $0.375 input and $2.25 output for the Singapore International deployment scope.
The same official pricing page gives the models.dev $0.248/$1.485 price for Global deployment scope; the lower value is a deployment scope distinction, not an indicated later price change.

notes: Classified as models_dev_fix because Alibaba's own page distinguishes the higher Singapore International price from the $0.248/$1.485 Global price. No captured source establishes that tier structure at or near 2026-04-27; an attempt to extract an April 2026 Internet Archive pricing snapshot returned HTTP 429, so the launch-era point remains unverified.
